name: PDF & Image Tools
tagline: PDF & Image Tools is a free suite of PDF and image tools that run entirely in your browser
description: PDF & Image Tools is a free suite of PDF and image tools that run entirely in your browser. Nothing is ever uploaded: every task runs locally on your device, so your files never touch a server (you can verify it by opening your browser's Network tab, or by turning off Wi-Fi after the page loads).
